subject: E-Commerce
title: AI Shopping Assistants
description: A 60-second lesson on AI Shopping Assistants.

hook.text: Amazon's AI assistant Rufus answers product questions and recommends items. AI may replace browsing with conversations.

buildup.text: Instead of scrolling through search results, you'll tell an AI what you need and it will find the best option.

discovery.text: Google's AI shopping agent compares prices, reads reviews, and makes purchase recommendations autonomously.

twist.text: If AI chooses products for you, listings and ads become irrelevant. The entire marketplace advertising model breaks.

climax.text: AI shopping assistants threaten the core revenue model of every marketplace. They're building the tool disrupts them.

punchline.text: AI picks the product, ads ignored. Marketplaces are building the technology.

quiz.question: Why could AI shopping assistants disrupt marketplace business models?
options: If AI selects products directly, sponsored listings and ads become irrelevant
